svg.title: One Prospect Cohort, Five Measurable Conversions
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-02-local-account-conversion-cohort; chart type: funnel; title: One Prospect Cohort, Five Measurable Conversions; subtitle: Illustrative account counts; every downstream account belongs to the original cohort.; chapter number: 6; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Follow 200 unique local accounts for up to 120 days, consistent with a one-to-four-month first-deal planning range. Counts are illustrative, not market benchmarks or annual revenue projections. Referred or newly discovered accounts enter separate cohorts.; caption: The cohort narrows from 200 researched accounts to five activated contracts: 2.5% overall conversion without mixing leads and locations.; stages: label: Researched accounts; value: 200 unique accounts matching the service territory; numeric value: 200.0; detail: Deduplicate legal buyers and document facility type, route distance, estimated cleaning frequency, and a reachable purchasing contact before counting an account.; label: Qualified conversations; value: 80 accounts with confirmed need and purchasing access; numeric value: 80.0; detail: Forty percent of the original accounts confirm a relevant service need, a buyer contact, and a plausible buying window. Email opens and unanswered calls do not qualify.; label: Completed walkthroughs; value: 40 accounts with measured sites and service requirements; numeric value: 40.0; detail: Fifty percent of qualified conversations produce a completed site inspection with task inventory, access conditions, existing service problems, and invoice requirements.; label: Delivered proposals; value: 20 accounts receive costed and capacity-checked proposals; numeric value: 20.0; detail: Fifty percent of walkthrough accounts receive priced scopes after labor-hour costing and route review. Decline work that cannot cover required wages and delivery costs.; label: Activated contracts; value: Five accounts sign and begin accepted service; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Twenty-five percent of proposed accounts sign and start service within the observation window. Track deposits, earned revenue, invoiced receivables, and cash collections separately.

text.title: One Prospect Cohort, Five Measurable Conversions
text.tspan: One Prospect Cohort, Five Measurable Conversions

circle.title: label: Researched accounts; value: 200 unique accounts matching the service territory; numeric value: 200.0; detail: Deduplicate legal buyers and document facility type, route distance, estimated cleaning frequency, and a reachable purchasing contact before counting an account.

label: Qualified conversations; value: 80 accounts with confirmed need and purchasing access; numeric value: 80.0; detail: Forty percent of the original accounts confirm a relevant service need, a buyer contact, and a plausible buying window. Email opens and unanswered calls do not qualify.

label: Completed walkthroughs; value: 40 accounts with measured sites and service requirements; numeric value: 40.0; detail: Fifty percent of qualified conversations produce a completed site inspection with task inventory, access conditions, existing service problems, and invoice requirements.

label: Delivered proposals; value: 20 accounts receive costed and capacity-checked proposals; numeric value: 20.0; detail: Fifty percent of walkthrough accounts receive priced scopes after labor-hour costing and route review. Decline work that cannot cover required wages and delivery costs.

label: Activated contracts; value: Five accounts sign and begin accepted service; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Twenty-five percent of proposed accounts sign and start service within the observation window. Track deposits, earned revenue, invoiced receivables, and cash collections separately.

text.title: Assumptions: Follow 200 unique local accounts for up to 120 days, consistent with a one-to-four-month first-deal planning range. Counts are illustrative, not market benchmarks or annual revenue projections. Referred or newly discovered accounts enter separate cohorts.
text.tspan: Assumptions: Follow 200 unique local accounts for up to 120 days, consistent with a one-to-four-month first-deal planning range.
